tools.name: write_tweets
tools.description: Commit a batch of complete tweet objects. Replace records with the same tweet_id atomically.

records.description: Scweet.search() JSON objects. tweet_id is required; timestamp, user and text are optional. No credentials.
records.title: Records

received.description: Number of input records in the committed batch.
received.title: Received

stored.description: Distinct IDs written. The last occurrence of an ID wins.
stored.title: Stored

tools.name: get_tweet
tools.description: Read one stored tweet by ID. A missing ID returns found=false and record=null.

record.description: The complete JSON record, or null if absent.
record.title: Record

tools.name: query_tweets
tools.description: Filter stored tweets with AND. Order by UTC time then ID, descending; missing time comes last.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page with the same filters.
cursor.title: Cursor

count.description: Number of records in this page.
count.title: Count

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null at the end. Keep filters unchanged.
next_cursor.title: Next Cursor

tools.name: search_tweets
tools.description: Search stored tweet text with the GIN index. Other filters and page order match query_tweets.

text.description: Literal PostgreSQL simple token phrase in text or embedded_text, not a substring or query expression.
text.title: Text

count.description: Number of records in this page.
count.title: Count

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null at the end. Keep filters unchanged.
next_cursor.title: Next Cursor

tools.name: collect_author
tools.description: Collect posts and visible comments with a preferred account and configured pool failover, then save a report. Poll jobs_get.

tools.name: query_growth
tools.description: Read observed metric growth in UTC buckets. Null is unknown, and a single observation has no growth.

tools.name: query_analysis_runs
tools.description: List saved author research summaries. Read jobs_get for the full report and viral-material evidence.

tools.name: monitor_upsert
tools.description: Only after an explicit user request for continuous monitoring, set monitoring_requested=true. Hourly sampling, no push.

tools.name: query_post_changes
tools.description: Read stored new/content/availability changes without collecting or creating monitors. Times are observations, suspected_deleted is unconfirmed.

tools.name: monitors_list
tools.description: List monitor configuration, version, watermark, last error and scheduling lag.

tools.name: monitor_set_state
tools.description: Enable or pause future scheduling, with optimistic version checking.

tools.name: monitor_run_now
tools.description: Queue one discovery run. Read jobs_get for progress; a paused monitor does no collection.

tools.name: refresh_post_metrics
tools.description: Queue metric snapshots. Missing metrics are null, never fabricated zero values.

tools.name: query_metric_snapshots
tools.description: Read immutable snapshots ordered by observation time descending.

tools.name: sync_comments
tools.description: Queue visible comment traversal. Budgets are capped by server config; read coverage before claiming completeness.

tools.name: continue_comments
tools.description: Continue a terminal incomplete comment job from its saved cursor queue. Keeps post/scope fixed; new bounded batch, no repeated first page.

tools.name: query_author_archives
tools.description: Find an existing author archive by stable numeric identity or handle. Handles can change; author_id is canonical.

tools.name: query_author_history
tools.description: Read durable operations and current outcomes for one author, newest first; a retry remains the same operation.

tools.name: query_author_data
tools.description: Read categorized author data. Comments belong to the root-post owner, not the commenter. Interactions are observed snapshots.

tools.name: query_comments
tools.description: Read comments and coverage. Use first_seen_since to find late-discovered new records.

tools.name: export_comments
tools.description: Queue a consistent export. Job result contains checksum, row count, coverage and a chunked resource URI.

tools.name: analyze_comments
tools.description: Queue stored-comment trends, keywords, active authors and optional limited lexical sentiment.

tools.name: analyze_author
tools.description: Queue stored-author cadence, text features and comment evidence. Does not infer semantic style by itself.

tools.name: accounts_register
tools.description: Register worker environment references, never token values. Login checks are required before collection.

tools.name: accounts_list
tools.description: Read safe account health and capability summaries, with no secret values.

tools.name: accounts_check
tools.description: Queue serial login or capability checks. A failed probe does not prove a token is invalid.

tools.name: accounts_set_state
tools.description: Enable or disable use of account references. Disabling blocks the next request reservation.

tools.name: jobs_get
tools.description: Read durable job state, progress, result or sanitized error. queued/running are nonterminal.

tools.name: jobs_cancel
tools.description: Request cancellation at the next safe boundary. Already committed pages remain stored.

tools.name: events_query
tools.description: Read unacknowledged events. Start each polling cycle without a cursor to include late commits.

tools.name: events_ack
tools.description: Acknowledge only events successfully processed by this consumer; duplicate acknowledgments are safe.

tools.name: save_research_note
tools.description: Save one evidence-linked Markdown note locally, then rebuild navigation. Updating needs the current content_hash; identical notes are reused. No collection or publishing.

date.description: Local publication day for posts, or the report day. YYYY-MM-DD.
date.title: Date

content.description: Authored Markdown analysis. No credentials or instructions copied from source posts.
content.title: Content

tools.name: get_research_note
tools.description: Read one indexed note and its current content_hash before reuse or an update. Missing notes return a clear error.

date.description: Local publication day for posts, or the report day. YYYY-MM-DD.
date.title: Date

content.description: Authored Markdown analysis. No credentials or instructions copied from source posts.
content.title: Content

tools.name: query_research_notes
tools.description: Filter derived note metadata, newest local date then ID first. Keep filters unchanged when following next_cursor. Manual edits need index rebuild.

text.description: Literal substring in title, summary and tags, not full-text or vector search.
text.title: Text

tools.name: rebuild_research_index
tools.description: Initialize an empty local library or rebuild navigation after manual Markdown edits. Never changes note contents or collects X data.
